description: White-label local visibility report for one business, returned as an application/pdf file (not JSON): Google Business Profile completeness, organic ranking for a target keyword and AI answer-engine visibility for a buyer-intent query. No TariffMonkee branding appears in the output, so agencies can present it under their own name. Costs $0.15 per call via x402.

business.description: Business name to audit. For chains or common names, add the street address (for example 'Philz Coffee 3101 24th St').

domain.description: The business's own website domain, used for the search-ranking and AI-citation checks.

keyword.description: Search keyword to check this business's organic ranking for.

location.description: City, region and country of the business, for example 'San Francisco, CA', 'Austin, Texas, United States' or 'Taichung, Taiwan'.

query.description: Buyer-intent question to check whether an AI model mentions this business when answering. Max 500 characters.

name: tariffmonkee-visibility-report
